ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state behavior when a light client receives an update spanning a fork boundary (attested slot pre-Electra, finalized slot post-Electra).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the gindex is selected based on the attested slot's epoch, meaning the proof structure must match the beacon state at that slot. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between 'frozen' Altair indices and new Electra indices suggests BeaconState structural changes, but the exact field additions causing the index shift are not detailed in this document.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the Electra BeaconState has additional fields inserted before the finalized_checkpoint and sync_committee fields, causing generalized indices to shift. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The light client trusts that the sync committee signatures represent an honest supermajority and cannot be forged.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker controlling sync committee keys could provide fraudulent light client updates, misleading light clients about finalized state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients have access to the correct fork schedule (ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, DENEB_FORK_EPOCH, etc.) to select the right generalized indices.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Wrong fork epoch configuration would cause Merkle proof validation to fail or accept invalid proofs.
